description: This file defines an API endpoint class EmployeeLeaveBalanceAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It handles HTTP requests to retrieve an employee's leave balance data, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class implements methods for fetching leave balances, applying date range filters, and generating API responses, along with API documentation annotations.
